newsitem.title: FRANCE: Seita weakens further on 2nd French suit.
newsitem.headline: Seita weakens further on 2nd French suit.

text.p: Shares in French tobacco group Seita continued to weaken on Friday, after the launch of a second French lawsuit claiming damages for a cancer death.

A broker said the shares would be hit by Thursday's news that a family of a young woman who died in October had sued Seita on grounds it sold an "inherently dangerous" product due to its addictive nature and its link to cancer.
Seita stock traded down 1.34 percent to 214.10 francs at 0924 GMT, extending Thursday's decline after the announcement of the latest lawsuit. It is the second French action announced since last week.
